title: DSSX
description: A Minecraft 1.12.2 server network with Hunger Games, Anarchy, and Survival servers stuck in the past replicating the golden age of Minecraft from the 2010s.
body:
# DSSX

## 🌎 Website: 
https://dssx.uk OR https://dssx.us

## 🌐 Connection Info
Eaglercraft (1.5.2, 1.8.8, 1.12.2):  wss://mc.dssx.uk,  wss://mc.dssx.us, wss://eagler.site, wss://eaglercraft.uk

Java (1.7.2 - 26.1.2): mc.dssx.uk, mc.dssx.us, eagler.site, eaglercraft.uk

Bedrock (1.21.130 - 26.23): mc.dssx.uk:19132, mc.dssx.us:19132, eagler.site:19132, eaglercraft.uk:19132

## Peaceful Features:
- NO WORLD BORDER (30,000,000 x 30,000,000)
- Eaglercraft, Java, & Bedrock crossplay
- Wide variety of versions supported
- Anti-cheat + Anti-Baritone
- Great + large staff team
- Strict rules that we actually enforce
- Welcoming community & peaceful server to enjoy
- Hosted in UK

## Hunger Games:
We have a hunger games server, Same rules as peaceful, with the exception of the killing ones of course. Use /rules for more info.

Features
- 5 Maps (Fallen City, 2fort, Breeze Island, Cavern, OG Hunger Games [from the movie])
- Anticheat
- Leaderboard + Statistics
- Win coins & sponsor players, or buy kits
- Also hosted in UK

## Chaos:
We have a semi-anarchy server, the only rules are chat related and no lag machines. See these with /rules.

Features:
- ALSO NO WORLD BORDER (30,000,000 x 30,000,000)
- 9 month old world
- No anticheat
- All dupes allowed (+ Item Frame Dupe, 5% chance)
- Also hosted in UK

## Why we are different:
We are competent, not half-assed, we actually care and don't let things slip under the rules

## 📊 Server Statistics
Check out our stats: https://plan.dssx.uk OR https://plan.dssx.us
